restoration_note: The teaching catalogues three states of perception (clouds) that bear influx — rising from fire (love), water (natural truth), and wind (thought) — each appearing in the air-of-the-midst over against the Virgin of Light. Editor restorations are largely confirmed by the formulaic structure: each cloud has its 'sign,' the archons clothe themselves with what they reach upon, and the Lord's discriminating operations (angels) strip them. Many small gaps (single letters, plural articles, suffix completions) are constrained by the surrounding morphology. Larger lacunae in sections 4764–4765, 4793–4795, 4798, 4802–4804, 4813–4814 remain unrestorable: the parallel formulas are partially preserved but the specific lexical content of those particular clauses is too damaged to reconstruct without invention. The cosmographic finale (seven fossae, great sea, Omophoros) is recoverable from the lexicon's standard Manichaean cosmography.
